title: Uniform Remix 솔로 #142 · 교복 · 오프숄더 체크 × 플리츠 · 힐 · towering hourglass · 정면 팔 내림 · 배경 가을 단풍길 · 인스타글램
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous warm-ivory complexion, early 20s goddess, towering hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a towering frame with legs that seem endless, thick smooth thighs and calves, hips wide and rounded, a sharply cinched narrow waist pulled in far tighter than her bust and hips, and a full heavy bust high on her chest; her height and long legs make every curve look longer and more dramatic; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, high ponytail golden blonde hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school uniform set, a cropped long-sleeve button-style shirt of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey with the collar and neckline slipped low off both shoulders so that her shoulders and collarbones are bare, a loose red ribbon tie hanging at her chest, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the modal jersey fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and a micro pleated skirt of red tartan plaid modal jersey sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending just below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and a small beauty mark near her lips. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the shirt slipping off her shoulders, the loose red ribbon and the crisp tartan pleats, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Pose: standing tall facing the camera straight on, arms relaxed at her sides, weight even on both feet, her legs fully in view — most extreme towering hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy red leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in red lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Chinese woman (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows sweaty oiled skin, post-workout glistening.

Background: a maple avenue in full autumn colour with a pale path scattered with red and gold leaves, a standard park bench and lamp posts, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
